newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end near lows, more volatility seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end near lows, more volatility seen.

text.p: MADRID, Feb 19 (Reuter) 1515 GMT - Madrid stocks slid lower at the end dragged down by a weak Wall Street and closing near lows on Wednesday after a choppy trading day.
Dealers said Spain's share market is likely to remain volatile, at least in the short run, as it closely tracks Spanish bonds and the peseta amid EMU blues and the U.S. dollar's unclear trend.
The general index fell 1.87 points, 0.39 percent, to 479.42 and the Ibex-35 lost 23.73 points, 0.43 percent, to 5,481.42.
"This market is strange. It's almost impossible to define a clear trend because each stock is moving along its own trend," a dealer in a Madrid bank said.
Banks were mixed, with BCH gaining 1.8 percent and Bankinter losing 1.5, while Argentaria and Santander gained.
Santander added 120 pesetas to reach 9,880 amid market talk of key management changes.
Almost all electrical firms lost ground. Endesa fell 140 pesetas, or 1.4 percent, to 9,000. Iberdrola was down five pesetas to 1,665 and Gas Natural was down 1.88 percent.
Telefonica remained unchanged at 3,365 pesetas after heavy trade, while Repsol ended down 20 pesetas.
